mentions.title: king Main&Rod Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Honda-Tech all-motor thread where King main and rod bearings are reported as failing during initial startup and break-in, leaving the builder needing the crank turned. Single builder, cause not established.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread on a diesel truck forum about King main thrust bearings. Title itself is a warning to other builders, which is the most damaging format a mention can take.

mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: Builders report a 2024 King main out of spec on free spread and a 2025 main also reported bad, framed as a possible manufacturing process problem. King has already posted an official reply in this thread.
mentions.replyNote: A new member account identifying as King Bearings posted an official response on 2026-08-04 addressing the precision concerns; thread remains open.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW M5 forum thread reporting King STDX thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit S85 and S65 blocks, with the poster concluding King bearings cannot be trusted on basic specification.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a sealed King package with mixed sizes (8 x .011 uppers, 7 x .011 lowers, 1 x .030 lower) and complains the response was to push him back through the distributor rather than resolve it. Packaging QC plus service complaint.
